We understand that the Brand Review concerns the application of the existing identity across all parks, sites and communication touchpoints, with a written findings and recommendations report as the deliverable. Drone services – operator requirements and restricted operations Question 4: Reference: Terms of Reference Articles 2.2(g), 3.2(b) and 4.2(4); Special Conditions Articles 18.2 and 19.2; Clarification Meeting Minutes, Answer 9. We acknowledge that permit costs are borne by the contractor. Please specify any tender- specific qualifications, authorisations and insurance evidence required for the drone pilot, and confirm whether the pilot must also meet the minimum qualifications and experience prescribed for Key Expert 2 or may be a separate specialist. Please clarify how deadlines and penalties will be treated where drone operations are prevented by adverse weather, flight restrictions or delays in permissions outside the contractor’s control, including whether rescheduling or alternative ground-based coverage may be agreed. Answer 4: The Contractor is to provide drone footage and photos, including the pilot (Terms of Reference, Article 2.2(g)). The Contractor shall maintain any insurance required by law or reasonably necessary for the performance of the contract (Special Conditions, Article 13.3). Page 4 of 10 The drone pilot shall hold the operator registration, pilot competency certificate and aut

all be submitted upon request. The pilot may be a separate specialist and is not required to meet the criteria set for Key Expert 2. Weekly, monthly and final reporting requirements Question 5: Reference: Special Conditions Articles 24.1 and 19.2; Terms of Reference Articles 7.1–7.2. Article 24.1 requires weekly and monthly interim reports and a final report but describes only the monthly and final reports. Article 7.1 of the Terms of Reference likewise describes only monthly and final reports. Please confirm whether separate weekly reports are mandatory and specify their required content and format. Please provide the submission deadlines for weekly, monthly and final reports, and identify the deadlines against which late- report penalties will be assessed. Answer 5: Separate weekly written reports are not required. Weekly progress shall be discussed in the weekly meetings referred to in Article 4.3.2 of the Terms of Reference. The monthly interim progress report shall cover the works carried out in the relative month, including a breakdown of the hours allocated by type of service and metrics from all relevant platforms. deliverables_scope.text: rativsystem – og det samme må tilbudte løsninger kunne gjøre. Servere patches normalt sett ila 2-3 dager etter de er sluppet. Alt av servere og klienter kjører Trend Vision One XDR. For løsninger i sikker sone kjøres fagsystemene på Citrix – og tilbudte onprem løsninger må dermed kunne kjøre på eksisterende Citrix infrastruktur. Løsninger som leveres skal benytte vårt eksisterende nettverk (LAN). Nettverksstandarder • 10/100/1000 BaseT nettverk • Power over ethernet( 802.3af eller 802.3at) • WIFI 802.11 g/n/ac • Reservert og ikke registrert IP-adresse fra DHCP server • Kryptering av all datakommunikasjon • Kamera må støtte Milestone og kunne benyttes på denne løsningen. • Adgangskontroll må støtte og kunne brukes fult ut med Lenel Onguard som Harstad kommune benytter som adgangskontroll-løsning. Visma Enterprise HRM benyttes som kildesystem for de ansatte. HRM er integrert mot Microsoft Active Directory via Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM). Dermed opprettes, endres og stenges brukerkontoer i AD automatisk basert på kildedata fra HRM. Enhetsgrupper som kan brukes til tilgangsstyring bygges og vedlikeholdes automatisk basert på organisasjonsstrukturen. Brukere må kunne importeres fra Active Directory eller integreres for pålogging via AD-konto til den enkelte
